_comment: Token values extracted from src/app/globals.css on 2026-07-26. Path-independent source of truth for rebuilding foundations in a fresh Figma file (the original foundations were built via MCP and never scripted). Consumed by either the MCP route or a Scripter 00-foundations.js.
_note: The old file cmFt5G4SRLrDXGmHHSb0PS holds 56 primitives; CSS yields 41 hex tokens. The remainder were derived tints/shades created during the MCP build. Read the old file to recover the exact set once MCP quota is available.

radius._comment: radius/none is the brand default — square corners on site and store are deliberate. Rounding is reserved for MIS and admin.

elevation._comment: Gold-tinted on brand surfaces, neutral on internal tools.

fonts._trap: Inter spells it 'Semi Bold' and 'Extra Bold' WITH a space; Cormorant Garamond, DM Sans and Fraunces use 'SemiBold' without. Verify with listAvailableFontsAsync().

layout._gutter_note: 80px, NOT the literal CSS 24px from min(90rem, 100% - 3rem). 24px reads as no padding in a Figma canvas.

planNotes.starter: 1 mode per collection and 3 pages per file. Cream/dark encoded in token NAMES; hierarchy via Sections.
planNotes.professional: Convert the cream/* and dark/* token groups into real light/dark MODES, and split Sections back into proper pages.
